subject: Fixed and Random effects in both components of zero-inflated binomial

messages.author: 3ab4a021861e22ff
messages.subject: Fixed and Random effects in both components of zero-inflated binomial
parts:
Hello,

I am wondering if it is possible to fit a zero-inflated binomial model including fixed and random effects in both model components? I ideally wish to incorporate both spatial and temporal random effects in both the zero-inflation and binomial processes. I am currently using 'zeroinflatedbinomial1'. I'm also aware of '0binomial' but the vignette makes it clear that you can only include random effects in one component with this pdf. 

Thanks for any help,

Ciar

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fixed and Random effects in both components of zero-inflated binomial
parts:
you can check inla.doc("0binomial"), which allow for fixed+random in one
component and fixed in the other.

to have fixed+random in both: just a matter of coding, and its a lot of
work
